name: Fall Lid
description: Hold the handle low in a loose fist and let the thong trail so its swaying line guards the front.

name: Keeper Strike
description: Snap the forearm forward and stop it short so the thong whips straight out and slaps the target.

name: Quick Tether
description: Circle the handle above the head once to gather speed then bring the thong down on a vertical line.

name: Plaithop
description: Slide one foot sideways while the thong still flies so the body leaves the line of the opponent's attack.

name: Lowered Popper
description: A roll of the wrist curls the thong back along the arm and turns aside a poke that enters the guard.

name: Snapdash
description: Drop the hand to the hip and sweep the thong along the ground to catch the lower legs.

name: Whiptail Note
description: Grip the handle with the palm turned under and feel the thong's weight so every swing starts from a steady hand.

name: Downward Flick
description: End a forward lash with a sharp pull of the elbow so the cracker snaps against the target's face.

name: Thongcowl
description: Trace slow figure eights beside the body so the moving thong forms a screen against thrown stones.

name: Shifting Popcrack
description: Cross the rear leg behind the lead foot and shift away while the thong stays out in front.

name: Locking Snap
description: Whirl the thong once around the opponent's wrist and draw the turn snug to restrain the arm.

name: Flickdrop
description: The thong swings upward from below the waist so its tail lifts and cuts under the jaw.

name: Poppercowl
description: Pull the thong back in mid-flight to bat away a reaching hand before it can grip the line.

name: Descending Plait
description: The wrist alone drives a short flick so the thong tip stings the target's hand with no arm swing.

name: Falldrop
description: Turn the hips first and let the arm follow so the thong snaps out carrying the weight of the body.

name: Raised Lashcore
description: Spin the thong in a steady flat circle at chest height so its hum and bite keep rushers at a distance.

name: Hitching Whipheel
description: Loop the thong tip behind an advancing ankle and tug back hard to break the stride.

name: Falltrot
description: Step back along a slight curve while flicking the thong forward to cover the withdrawal.

name: Firm Furl
description: Step forward fully and extend the arm so the thong lands at its longest reach on the target's shoulder.

name: Keepergauge
description: Draw in the loose thong in even loops while watching the opponent so the next cast leaves clean.

name: Thongdrop
description: Carry the thong back over the shoulder in one arc and throw it forward in a single stroke.

name: Lashdash
description: Send the thong in low and let it curve upward to strike the ribs beneath a raised guard.

name: Resting Whipstock
description: A short fan of thong across the front lets an arriving staff slide off its slack.

name: Backward Lashend
description: Swivel on the lead heel as the cast leaves the hand so the body shows only a narrow side.

name: Keeperpause
description: Pin the elbow to the ribs and tug the thong back to pull a snagged opponent off balance.

name: Blunt Thong
description: Throw two casts in one breath so the second stroke lands while the first is still being blocked.

name: Quick Lash
description: Crack the popper beside the opponent's ear to startle them and make them flinch off the line.

name: Narrow Keeper
description: Let the fall drop onto an exposed forearm with a flat slap that numbs the grip.

name: Thongpause
description: Roll the thong forward in loops at the front so thrown debris is knocked out of the air.

name: Gnawing Plait
description: Bring the thong back across the body with the back of the hand leading so the return bites the flank.

name: Quiet Lashcore
description: Gather the slack in one pull and take two quick strides back out of the opponent's reach.

name: Plaithusk
description: Twist the fall into a loose knot around a weapon shaft and pull to drag it down.

name: Open Whiptail
description: Run a thin thread of qi down the thong as the arm throws so the tip lands harder.

name: Angled Whipstock
description: Keep the thong spinning in a flat ring fed by a trickle of qi so it stays taut against blows.

name: Smooth Lashend
description: Rest the thong tip on the ground ahead and read the qi of anything nearby through the line.

name: Furlpace
description: Push off the ball of the foot with a pulse of qi and lash just as the stride lands.

name: Pushing Furl
description: Wind the thong around a limb and tighten it with a short qi pulse to hold the limb in place.

name: Solid Thong
description: Meet a blade flat with the thong and flick it off the line with a burst of qi.

name: Sharp Tether
description: A sharp crack fired across the opponent's eyeline makes their forward step falter.

name: Forward Popcrack
description: Swing the short whip in a tight circle at the wrist and let qi snap the tip into the target.

name: Whipheel Pause
description: Turn the short whip in a close ring around the torso with qi in the tail to bar every angle.

name: Tripping Snap
description: Loop the short thong around a reaching wrist and jerk the knot tight with a pulse of qi.

name: Nimble Thong
description: Step inside the opponent's reach on the downswing of a circuit so the next lash lands at arm's length.

name: Kind Popper
description: Let the loose tip flutter in the air and feel for the push of anyone moving up behind.

name: Lashbump
description: Hold the thong gathered in the off hand and release it with qi so the coil unwinds into a long strike.

name: Judging Fall
description: Carry the coil over the shoulder and sense how its weight shifts so the release can be timed.

name: Fixing Snap
description: Throw a wide loose loop over an opponent's arm and pull the slack closed with qi.

name: Stiff Flick
description: Bring the coil from the hip in an upward arc so the tail snaps under the opponent's guard.

name: Solid Plait
description: Hold the half-open coil above the head to catch a downward blow in its turns.

name: Furlhop
description: Let go of the coil and spring backward on the same breath so the lash covers the retreat.

name: Thongwedge
description: After the thong snags a weapon give it a hard pulse of qi and a sideways tug that wrenches the grip.

name: Lashcore Gauge
description: Count each loop of the coil by touch alone and know the exact reach left before the next throw.

name: Keeper Count
description: Feel through the handle where the thong is pulled taut and learn where an opponent's weight sits.

name: Wide Furl
description: Place qi at the bend of the thong so the line cracks hardest exactly where it meets the target.

name: Keeperstay
description: Hold the thong taut between both hands to stop a swung club and let it slide aside.

name: Pulling Lashend
description: Let the thong sag then jerk it up so the opponent reads a false line and steps into it.

name: Fall Pace
description: Lean the torso out of a cut and draw the thong back through the same motion.

name: Firm Whipstock
description: Whirl the thong so its qi-charged hum rises and holds a nervous opponent just beyond its reach.

name: Thongreview
description: Tap the thong tip against the opponent's guard to learn exactly how far away they stand.

name: Descending Tether
description: Push a pulse of qi to the last hand's width of the thong so the strike lands past normal reach.

name: Holding Popper
description: Whip the thong across the front at half length to bar a rusher who has closed the distance.

name: Thonghop
description: Skip forward on the off foot and lash on the landing to carry the strike across a gap.

name: Open Whipheel
description: A sharp crack at the opponent's lead foot discourages any step into the whip's reach.

name: Fouling Popper
description: Flick the tip around a sword wrist and hold it there a moment with a clench of qi.

name: Popperstay
description: Draw the handle to the chest so the shortened thong knocks a thrust off the line.

name: Lean Furl
description: Throw the plaited whip with qi held in its stiff core so the stroke lands without whip-back.

name: Fall Stay
description: Weave the plaited thong in a slow ward before the body to catch arrows and thrown knives.

name: Skipping Flick
description: Practice short gliding steps in time with each lash until stride and stroke become one motion.

name: Turning Popcrack
description: Spiral two strands of the braid around an opponent's forearm and draw them tight.

name: Kind Thong
description: Run a breath of qi through the braid and feel any weak strand before it fails in use.

name: Short Plait
description: End the practice with one slow heavy stroke that lays the braid flat along the ground.
